description: This is a PHP source file defining the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class manages data access operations related to 'Buzz' social feed features, including retrieving, saving, deleting posts, shares, comments, likes, and related entities in the Buzz module.

classes.name: BuzzDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling operations related to the Buzz social feed, including retrieving, saving, deleting posts, shares, comments, and interactions.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Buzz feed posts based on specified filtering parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Buzz feed posts matching given filters.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Fetches photo IDs associated with a specific Buzz post.

methods.name: saveBuzzPost
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPost entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzShare entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLink (video link) entity.

methods.name: saveBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPhoto entity.

methods.name: saveBuzzComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: deleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Removes a BuzzComment entity from the database.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPhoto by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzShareById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzComment by its ID, optionally filtered by share ID.

methods.name: getBuzzComments
methods.description: Fetches a list of Buzz comments based on search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Buzz comments matching search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for Buzz comments based on filters.

methods.name: isEmployeeLikedOnComment
methods.description: Checks if an employee has liked a specific comment.

methods.name: getBuzzPostById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPost by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzPostTypeByPostId
methods.description: Determines the type of a Buzz post (photo, video, text) based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPostPhotos
methods.description: Deletes photos associated with a Buzz post given their IDs.

methods.name: getBuzzLinkByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLink associated with a Buzz post.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPost
methods.description: Deletes a Buzz post by its ID.

methods.name: deleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Deletes a Buzz share by its ID.

methods.name: adjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the number of likes and comments on each share.

methods.name: adjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the number of likes on comments.

methods.name: getBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare related to a specific post ID.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Buzz shares associated with a specific post, filtered by sharing parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of Buzz shares for a specific post based on filters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for Buzz shares related to a specific post, with filtering options.
